definition.en: The subsistence base and food production system that sustained the urban centers of the Indus Valley Civilisation.

importanceInUpsc.en: UPSC frequently tests agricultural technology, major crops, and irrigation methods from this era in Prelims. Understanding the agrarian surplus is crucial for Mains answers on the socio-economic foundations of India's first urbanization.
importanceInUpsc.hi: यूपीएससी प्रीलिम्स में इस युग की कृषि तकनीक, प्रमुख फसलों और सिंचाई के तरीकों से जुड़े सवाल अक्सर पूछता है। भारत के पहले शहरीकरण की सामाजिक-इकॉनॉमिक नींव पर मेंस के उत्तरों के लिए कृषि अधिशेष (Agrarian Surplus) को समझना महत्वपूर्ण है।

content.en: Agriculture formed the crucial economic backbone of the **Indus Valley Civilisation**, providing the sustained surplus necessary to support urbanisation, craft specialisation, and complex social stratification. The Harappans capitalised on the **inundation of river basins**, timing their agricultural operations with the seasonal flooding of the Indus River system and its tributaries. This natural irrigation system deposited fertile silt annually, renewing the soil nutrients without requiring intensive chemical fertilisation. The agrarian strategy was highly diversified, integrating both **winter (rabi) and summer (kharif) cropping patterns** to mitigate environmental risks and ensure food security across vast regional networks spanning parts of modern-day India and Pakistan.
content.hi: कृषि **सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता** की महत्वपूर्ण आर्थिक रीढ़ थी, जिसने शहरीकरण, शिल्प विशेषज्ञता और जटिल सामाजिक स्तरीकरण का समर्थन करने के लिए आवश्यक निरंतर अधिशेष प्रदान किया। हरप्पावासियों ने **नदी बेसिनों की बाढ़** का लाभ उठाया, अपनी कृषि गतिविधियों को सिंधु नदी प्रणाली और उसकी सहायक नदियों की मौसमी बाढ़ के साथ समयबद्ध किया। इस प्राकृतिक सिंचाई प्रणाली ने सालाना उपजाऊ जलोढ़ मिट्टी जमा की, जिससे गहन रासायनिक खाद की आवश्यकता के बिना मिट्टी के पोषक तत्व नवीनीकृत हो गए। कृषि रणनीति अत्यधिक विविध थी, जिसमें आधुनिक भारत और पाकिस्तान के कुछ हिस्सों में फैле विशाल क्षेत्रीय नेटवर्क में पर्यावरणीय जोखिमों को कम करने और खाद्य सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करने के लिए **सर्दियों (रबी) और गर्मियों (खरीफ) दोनों की फसल प्रणालियों** को एकीकृत किया गया था।

definition.en: Direct archaeological proof of ploughing comes from the discovery of a **terracotta model plough** at **Banawali** and an exceptionally early **ploughed field surface** discovered at **Kalibangan**, showing a grid pattern of two sets of furrows intersecting at right angles.

definition.en: While inundation canals were common along the floodplains, advanced water harvesting and conservation systems were developed in arid zones, most notably the **stone-cut reservoirs and dams** found at **Dholavira** in the Rann of Kutch.
definition.hi: While inundation canals were common along the floodplains, advanced water harvesting and संरक्षण systems were developed in arid zones, most notably the **stone-cut reservoirs and dams** found at **Dholavira** in the Rann of Kutch.

definition.en: Flint blades inserted into wooden or bone handles served as sickles for harvesting crops, while large-scale **granaries** found at major sites like **Harappa** and **Mohenjo-daro** indicate centralized storage and management of agricultural surplus.

content.en: Dominated by intensive cultivation of wheat and barley, supported by predictable river inundation and extensive riverine trade routes.
content.hi: Dominated by intensive cultivation of wheat and barley, supported by predictable river inundation and extensive riverine trade routes.

content.en: Adapted to a semi-arid climate by diversifying into drought-resistant crops such as millets (**ragi** and **bajra**) and engaging in multi-cropping strategies.
content.hi: Adapted to a semi-arid climate by diversifying into drought-resistant crops such as millets (**ragi** and **bajra**) and engaging in multi-cropping strategies.

content.en: Do not assume rice was the primary staple across the entire civilization; while found at sites like **Lothal** and **Rangpur**, wheat and barley remained the dominant cereals across the core Indus basin.

content.en: For Mains (GS-1), link agricultural surplus directly to the rise of urban centers and specialized craft production like metallurgy, bead-making, and seal engraving.

content.en: The earliest physical evidence of cultivated cotton globally comes from the Harappan civilization, where it was referred to as **'sindon'** by the Greeks.

keyTakeaways.en: Harappan agriculture relied on a dual-season cropping pattern combining winter cereals (wheat/barley) with summer millets and pulses.
keyTakeaways.hi: Harappan agriculture relied on a dual-season cropping pattern combining winter cereals (wheat/barley) with summer millets and pulses.

keyTakeaways.en: Technological innovations included terraced reservoirs at Dholavira, ploughed fields at Kalibangan, and terracotta model ploughs at Banawali.

keyTakeaways.en: Agricultural surplus was systematically stored in monumental granaries, serving as the economic engine for urbanism and long-distance trade.

clarification.en: Agriculture is the broad industry encompassing crop production, livestock, and forestry, whereas agronomy is the specific science and technology of producing and using plants for food, fuel, and fiber.
